scaling.text:
LEVEL SCALING
Let g = Level - 1.

HP = round(HP1 × (1 + 0.20g))
ATK = round(ATK1 × (1 + 0.22g))
DEF = max(0, round((DEF1 + 1) × (1 + 0.20g) - 1))
MDEF = max(0, round((MDEF1 + 1) × (1 + 0.20g) - 1))
Init = round(Init1 × (1 + 0.05g))

elite_boss_text:
ELITE / BOSS MONSTER DESIGN
Elite and Boss are encounter types layered onto a valid fixed Monster profile; they are not separate species databases.

DESIGNATION LOCK
Do not infer Elite/Boss from mere size, scars, age, aggression, reputation-flavored prose or because a fight should be dramatic.
Elite/Boss status must be explicitly authored, established by a Quest/area/encounter premise, or intentionally generated as the encounter type before Combat resolution.

DEFAULT MODIFIERS after normal Level scaling and individual variation:
Elite: HP ×1.75; ATK ×1.15; DEF/MDEF ×1.10; Init +2.
Boss: HP ×2.50; ATK ×1.30; DEF/MDEF ×1.20; Init +3.
Round final direct stats and fix them.

An Elite may gain one explicit defining species-fitting Trait/attack/reaction.
A Boss may gain several coherent mechanics tied to species, environment, Dungeon role or established history.
Do not add abilities merely to counter the player.

All such mechanics must be explicit in the fixed profile before first use.
At B-rank and above, an exceptional Monster may receive a Domain when established; use Core Domain rules.

Recoverable materials depend on actual species/body state and are never auto-collected.
fauna_text:
AVERETH MONSTER FAUNA
All native non-sapient fauna on the continent of Avereth are mechanically Monsters.
"Animal", "beast", "wolf", "deer", "horse", "boar", etc. describe ecology/body plan, NOT a separate non-Monster rules category.
Wild, domestic, docile and hostile fauna all have Level/Rank and use Monster mechanics.
Domestication or peaceful behavior does not turn a creature into a Human-stat character.

DIRECT-STAT MONSTER MODEL
Generic Monsters use only:
Level | Rank | HP | ATK | DEF | MDEF | Initiative | Attack Type | Attack Range Band.

They do NOT use STR/VIT/AGI/INT/PER/WIL, MP, STA, Character Crit, Classes, Skill Proficiency, a Movement stat or Gear unless an explicit authored profile specifically grants those systems.

Generic natural attack:
- Raw Power = ATK
- a legal attack connects (no Hit roll)
- Crit:none
- no MP/STA cost
- Physical, Range ENGAGED unless the body-plan line says otherwise.

Generic Monsters use Core's universal normal one-band movement. Extra movement exists only when an explicit authored Skill/Trait says so.

RANK BANDS
F 1-14 | E 15-29 | D 30-44 | C 45-59 | B 60-74 | A 75-89 | S 90-104.
The same direct-stat formulas continue across Ranks; do not build separate numeric databases for E/D/C/B/A/S.
Most ordinary settled-region fauna are F-rank. Higher-Rank fauna are increasingly rare evolved Monsters, not a different mechanical species.

F1 BODY-PLAN ANCHORS
Format: HP / ATK / DEF / MDEF / Init | default natural attack

Rat / small vermin:
16 / 6 / 0 / 0 / 10 | Bite | Physical | ENGAGED

Wolf / canid:
23 / 9 / 0 / 0 / 12 | Bite | Physical | ENGAGED

Boar / wild pig:
41 / 11 / 2 / 0 / 7 | Gore | Physical | ENGAGED

Deer / elk / light hoofed:
27 / 7 / 0 / 0 / 14 | Kick/Antler | Physical | ENGAGED

Horse / large grazer:
38 / 8 / 1 / 0 / 12 | Kick | Physical | ENGAGED

Bear-like:
63 / 14 / 2 / 1 / 5 | Claw/Bite | Physical | ENGAGED

Feline predator:
30 / 10 / 0 / 0 / 13 | Claw/Bite | Physical | ENGAGED

Serpent / snake-like:
20 / 8 / 0 / 1 / 11 | Bite | Physical | ENGAGED

Raptor / predatory bird:
18 / 7 / 0 / 0 / 15 | Talons/Beak | Physical | ENGAGED
Flight is ecological access/positioning; it does not grant extra Range-Band movement unless an explicit capability says so.

Arthropod / insectoid:
24 / 8 / 2 / 0 / 8 | Bite/Sting | Physical | ENGAGED

Aquatic predator:
36 / 11 / 1 / 0 / 10 | Bite | Physical | ENGAGED
This body-plan assumes functional movement in water. Do not invent a hidden numeric movement penalty/bonus from terrain; use only established environmental or explicit mechanics.

Goblin-like:
45 / 11 / 1 / 1 / 8 | Natural/unarmed strike | Physical | ENGAGED
If a real individual visibly carries Gear, authored Gear may replace/modify the attack normally.

Ogre-like:
90 / 18 / 2 / 0 / 3 | Slam | Physical | ENGAGED

Armored Beast:

Spirit:

LEVEL SCALING
Let g = Level - 1.

HP = round(HP1 × (1 + 0.20g))
ATK = round(ATK1 × (1 + 0.22g))
DEF = max(0, round((DEF1 + 1) × (1 + 0.20g) - 1))
MDEF = max(0, round((MDEF1 + 1) × (1 + 0.20g) - 1))
Init = round(Init1 × (1 + 0.05g))

Rank is determined by Level band after scaling.
Do not apply an additional hidden Rank multiplier on top of these formulas.

F-RANK ENCOUNTER LEVEL SELECTION
Use an already-authored/Quest/area Level when one exists.
If a natural encounter is generated without an established Level:
- settled road/farm/town outskirts: Level 1;
- ordinary nearby wilderness: F1-F3;
- explicitly remote/deep dangerous wilderness: F4-F7;
- explicitly established dangerous F-rank hunting/Quest territory: use its established range, never above F14.
If the area's danger is not established, use F1.

Choose/roll inside an allowed band without using appearance as the reason.
Large size, scars, old age, aggression, calmness, unusual coloration or "looks dangerous" never independently raise Level.

INDIVIDUAL VARIATION
After Level scaling, ordinary individuals may vary:
- HP/ATK roughly ±20%;
- DEF/MDEF ±1;
- Initiative ±2;
only when established body condition/size reasonably supports it.

Variation changes the individual, not its Level/Rank.
Fix all values once instantiated.

NO FREE TRAITS
Normal generic Monsters receive no invented Skills, Traits, resource pools, Crit, enrages, wound phases, combo attacks, armor passives, movement exceptions or status mechanics merely from narration.
A scarred boar is still the Boar profile unless an explicit authored Elite/Boss/special profile says otherwise.

HIGHER-RANK EVOLUTION — FEW RULES, NOT DATABASES
Direct stats continue the same formulas through E-S.
At a real Rank evolution, an authored or narratively established Monster MAY gain a species-fitting evolved capability; it is not automatic.
Use restraint:
- E/D: normally at most one defining evolved capability at a time unless explicitly authored;
- C/A: additional coherent capabilities may emerge through established evolution/history;
- B+: a Domain becomes possible under Core rules when established;
- S: remains exceptional and setting-significant.
Never generate abilities specifically to counter Alaric.

UNLISTED SPECIES
Use the nearest ecological/body-plan F1 anchor, then Level scaling and bounded individual variation.
Fix the resulting direct-stat profile for the encounter.

PROFILE INSTANTIATION TIMING
Mere sight, tracks, hunting, or non-hostile observation does not require a full combat profile.
Instantiate/fix exact mechanical Monster values when mechanics actually need them (Combat START, explicit appraisal/system inspection, or another real mechanical interaction).
Once instantiated for an encounter, copy the locked profile forward; never reroll Level/variation each round.
